answer: Each identity claims one anchor berth and locks a 70-credit voyage bond. Its voyage must pass three beacon toll posts; each signs the anchor serial and timestamp into the public beacon log. The toll rises per identity under one operator key: first 34 credits, k-th 34 plus 6 times k minus 1, so the 1000th fake pays 6028 and 1000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked bonds. One anchor carries one voyage at a time, so a rented-anchor ring stacking voyages on one serial shows overlapping timestamps and burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 34 once and reclaims its bond after a clean voyage.
